column1: # Altin Peak: the mine groans and the water seeps; every line leans on the collapse.

column3: We did it, {actor_name:1}!\nThe last of them is down.\nBut the mine still groans.{end_wait}
Why did Altin's guardian\nstatues turn on us?{page_break}Something woke them.\nIsn't that strange?{end_now}
And this carved room at\nthe bottom of the mine?\nIt feels like a tomb.{end_wait}

Maybe you see this sort of
thing all the time.{page_break}I do not. Stone carved
this deep means someone
hid it on purpose.{end_wait}
The statues are old, from\nbefore the rains. Perhaps\nthey guarded something.{end_wait}
A chest behind the statue!\nThe dust on it is thick,\nbut the lid is wet.{end_wait}
It all ties to these ruins\nburied under the mine...\nand to the rain, I think.{end_wait}
Tch!{pause_20_skippable} All this way\nand a dead end! The roof\ncreaks above us.{end_wait}
